verdict.rationale: The product's own API retrieves balances (Account Balance service) and transactions (Transaction Data Services), links accounts via Connect, and uses token-based auth, so an agent could operate core flows through the API. The official MCP server is documented only as a developer-assistance toolkit for answers and code generation, not an operational surface for live data. Missing for 10: an operational MCP surface for live actions, documented scoped or least-privilege credentials (auth is a partner-wide PartnerID/secret/appKey token), explicit link-session creation and connection-management endpoint docs, and independent hands-on corroboration of agent use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can operate the platform — create link sessions, retrieve balances and transactions, and manage connections through the API or an MCP surface with scoped credentials

citations.quote: The Account Balance service provides real-time or cached bank account balance information from your customer's Financial Institution (FI).
The Transaction Data Services provide account transaction data.
link them to at least one account via Connect
To create a token, you are required to provide the PartnerID along with the corresponding secret and appKey.
Transaction Aggregation can be refreshed using the endpoints described in Data Refresh
